SUP

045/2026

Effective from 09 SEP 2026 to 13 SEP 2026

Published on 25 JUN 2026

  International Sanicole Airshow 2026

1   Purpose and Timings

In order to accommodate the International Sanicole Airshow, a temporary set of airspaces is created which will be activated by NOTAM.

The airshow and rehearsals are planned on the following dates:

  • WED 09 SEP 2026: 0630 - 1700
  • THU 10 SEP 2026: 0630 - 1700
  • FRI 11 SEP 2026: 0630 - 1700
  • SAT 12 SEP 2026: 0630 - 2000
  • SUN 13 SEP 2026: 0630- 1700

4   Instructions for use

Because of the classification of TRA Sanicole, being class D, VFR traffic inside the TRA will not be separated towards IFR traffic outside the TRA. As from the moment there is IFR traffic inside the TRA, coordination between the appropriate Air Navigation Service Providers will be ensured.

Tactical (de-)activation within the NOTAM timings of the airspace described above will be described in a bilateral procedure between Kleine-Brogel TWR/APP and Brussels ACC.
